text: This report recommends the 2024 meeting schedule for the Sign Variance Committee. The proposed schedule is guided by City Council’s approved schedule, and the availability of virtual meeting space.

The Sign Variance Committee: 1. Approved the following 2024 meeting dates: Friday, February 2, 2024. Friday, March 1, 2024. Friday, April 5, 2024. Friday, May 10, 2024. Friday, June 7, 2024. Friday, September 6, 2024. Friday, October 18, 2024. Friday, November 15, 2024.
